entities.summary: France was represented at the Eurovision Song Contest 2013 with the song "L'enfer et moi" written by Boris Bergman and David Salkin, and performed by Amandine Bourgeois. The French broadcaster France Télévisions in collaboration with the television channel France 3 internally selected the French entry for the 2013 contest in Malmö, Sweden. "L'enfer et moi" was officially announced by France 3 as the French entry on 22 January 2013 and later the song was presented to the public as the contest entry on 13 March 2013.
